worldcombat.skill.spore.summary: Shakes off a bodyful of mushroom spores that erupt all around in an instant: every foe inside the radius is checked separately and almost never resists, and anyone touched drops asleep on the spot - unable to act, and waking the moment it is hit. It deals no damage, at the cost of a very short reach and the longest cooldown, and Grass types pass straight through the spores.
worldcombat.skill.spore.use.0: Put a whole pack of closing melee attackers to sleep at once
worldcombat.skill.spore.use.1: Pin one tough target at point-blank range
worldcombat.skill.spore.use.2: Open a sleep window for an ally's Dream Eater or Nightmare
worldcombat.skill.spore.description.0: Erupts in an instant around the user with radius %1$s, covering up to %2$s foes. It takes effect instantly - once inside the radius there is no time to dodge.
worldcombat.skill.spore.description.1: Each adjacent target is touched with %1$s chance (read only from the user — almost certain); once touched it sleeps for %2$s. Grass types pass through the spores.
worldcombat.skill.spore.dense.on: Dense spores: radius ×0.8, sleep ×1.2 and a higher touch chance, at the cost of cooldown ×1.15 and fewer foes covered.
worldcombat.skill.spore.dense.off: Loose spores: radius ×1.25, one more foe covered and cooldown ×0.9, at the cost of sleep ×0.85.
worldcombat.skill.spore.growth.0: From level %1$s up to %2$s foes covered.
worldcombat.skill.spore.growth.1: From level %1$s the sleep %2$s and the radius %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.spore.preference.dense: On: radius ×0.8, sleep ×1.2 and a higher touch chance, but cooldown ×1.15 and fewer foes covered — for dropping one adjacent target for good. Off (loose): radius ×1.25, one more foe covered and cooldown ×0.9, but sleep ×0.85.
worldcombat.skill.spore.preference.ai.mi: Only burst when at least this many foes are still awake inside the spore radius; 1 means burst whenever anyone awake is adjacent, higher waits for a crowd.
worldcombat.skill.spore.preference.ai.le: When on, the partner will also leave its post to burst; when off it only bursts where it already reaches.
worldcombat.skill.spore.sleep: While asleep a target cannot use moves, make ordinary attacks or move; any damage at all wakes it immediately, and otherwise it wakes when the %1$s is up.
